payload.title: Enforce hard byte-consumption bounds for filesystem reads
payload.summary: Complete the filesystem roadmap hard-bounded-read obligation: a finite max_bytes must bound actual byte consumption/allocation even if a regular file grows after its observed stat size. Preserve exact complete content up to the boundary, including streams returning short reads; consume no more than max_bytes+1 bytes to detect oversize. Reject a known oversize file before loading it and reject a growing oversized file without decoding it. Preserve None/unlimited behavior, zero and negative limit semantics, codec dispatch, metadata, resource closure and permission-error normalization. Preserve all unrelated file/model APIs. Do not change tests or acceptance. Ruff, formatting and strict typing are part of acceptance.
payload.benefit: A finite read budget bounds allocation during file growth, rather than rejecting only after unbounded allocation.
payload.uncertainty: Local task acceptance is not protected integration; historical implementation-specific read_bytes mocks require independently attributed updated regressions before publication.
dependencies: Existing codec dispatch and filesystem error normalization
